stem.text: Two similar spheres, each of mass $m$ and travelling with speed $v$, are moving towards each other.

stem.alt: Two circles, each labelled m, with arrows above them labelled v; the arrows point towards each other.

stem.text: The spheres have a head-on elastic collision.

A.text: The spheres stick together on impact.

B.text: The total kinetic energy after impact is $mv^{2}$.

C.text: The total kinetic energy before impact is zero.

D.text: The total momentum before impact is $2mv$.
